subject.title: [Bug]: Memory dreaming narrative/REM lane is given apply_patch and misuses it

question: What plugin subagent tool-scoping contract should OpenClaw support for prose-only internal plugin runs like memory-core Dream Diary?
rationale: The observable fix is clear, but choosing the permanent API shape affects the plugin SDK, gateway protocol, and tool authorization boundary, so automation should not invent the contract alone.

options.title: Add explicit no-tools or allowlist plumbing
options.body: Add a typed tool restriction field to plugin subagent runs, carry it through gateway agent params, and set the Dream Diary narrative lane to no tools or a minimal allowlist.

options.title: Add a named prose-only tool profile
options.body: Expose a narrower semantic profile such as prose-only or toolProfile none instead of a raw allowlist, then map it to the runner's empty-tool construction plan.

options.title: Use prompt-only mitigation
options.body: Tighten the narrative prompt without changing the tool surface, which is lower-risk to wire but leaves the security-sensitive exposure in place.

recommendation.title: Add explicit no-tools or allowlist plumbing
recommendation.body: Add a typed tool restriction field to plugin subagent runs, carry it through gateway agent params, and set the Dream Diary narrative lane to no tools or a minimal allowlist.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is centered on the gateway/plugin runtime boundary, where recent history ties this person to adjacent implementation and review context.
